input.command:
# Search for function handlers that call getById then look for service calls with raw id/issueId
# This is more reliable than trying to parse with awk

# First, get all handlers that call getById
lines_with_getbyid=$(grep -n "const issue = await svc\.getById" /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/server/src/routes/issues.ts | cut -d: -f1)

# For each line, find the handler name and check downstream calls
for line in $lines_with_getbyid; do
  # Look backwards to find handler start
  handler_start=$(awk -v target=$line 'NR < target && /const [a-zA-Z_]+: Handler = async/ { handler_line = NR; handler = $2 } END { print handler_line }' /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/server/src/routes/issues.ts)
  if [ -z "$handler_start" ]; then continue; fi
  
  # Get handler name
  handler_name=$(sed -n "${handler_start}p" /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/server/src/routes/issues.ts | sed 's/.*const //; s/: Handler.*//')
  
  # Get next router line to find end of handler
  next_router=$(awk -v target=$line 'NR > target && /^  router\./ { print NR; exit }' /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/server/src/routes/issues.ts)
  if [ -z "$next_router" ]; then next_router=3700; fi
  
  # Look for svc.X or feedback. or issueApprovalsSvc. calls with id/issueId in that range
  sed -n "${line},$((next_router-1))p" /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/server/src/routes/issues.ts | \
    grep -n "svc\.\|feedback\.\|issueApprovalsSvc\." | \
    grep -E "(^|[^a-zA-Z])id[,\)]|(^|[^a-zA-Z])issueId[,\)]" | \
    head -5
done | head -40
